- Recovers 20% HP

- Launches an additional Super Attack
- Performs a critical hit

- {passiveImg:forever}Ki +5 (up to +15)

- {passiveImg:forever}Chance of performing a critical hit 20%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 60%)
*When there are 3 "Majin Power" Category allies, 3 "Majin Buu Saga"
Category allies or 3 "Sworn Enemies" Category allies attacking in the
same turn*
- {passiveImg:once}Evades enemy's attack if HP is 1% or less when receiving
an attack
- Chance of evading enemy's attack 90%{passiveImg:up_g} if HP is 1% or less
when receiving an attack for 4 turns from the character's entry turn
and chance of evading enemy's attack 80%{passiveImg:up_g} if HP is 1% or less
when receiving an attack starting from the 5th turn from the
character's entry turn
- Damage reduction rate 10%{passiveImg:up_g} if HP is 1% or less when attacking
*When all allies are "Sworn Enemies" Category characters*
- All allies' chance of performing a critical hit 50%{passiveImg:up_g}
*At the end of turn*
- Recovers 30% HP
